steps.text: Hey, are you awake?
Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago
How are you feeling today?
Better
But I still feel guilty
I stayed home like you said but I feel like I let my colleagues down
Do not feel guilty, working there was not good for you anyway
I told you I would handle it for the work, and for your coworkers it is fine, you can still see them outside work
Yes that is true
But I do not want to be useless
I want to help
You are not useless, you are the one keeping everything running here
Also I am looking for something we can do together
I might have a lead
But I want to verify it before I commit you to anything
What kind of work?
Is it safe?
And is it legal?
Yes of course
It is mostly scheduling and meeting people in public
No bar
No late nights forced by a manager
Meeting people?
For what?
Passive Insight says how you frame your next response can change her reaction

options.text: It is like being a friend for a day, they pay for your time and company
It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only

steps.text: That sounds strange
People pay just to talk?
Some people feel really lonely
They want company without pressure
And you are good at making people feel safe
And who knows, maybe you will find someone you like
You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
I am too old for that
No you are not, you are beautiful and still young, just give yourself a chance
Hmm..I will see
Paid dates?
That is not really my world
It does not mean you owe anything to anyone, it is more like acting for a day
It is time and conversation
It pays really well
And we set boundaries before you accept any client so there is no risk
And who knows, maybe you will find someone
You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
I am too old for that
No you are not, you are beautiful, just give yourself a chance
I will see
But i do not like the idea of being judged
No one will judge you
And you will not be alone in this, I will check everything, check with the client and watch over you all day
For now I will verify the platform and the rules
If anything feels wrong we drop it
Alright
I can try it and if I do not like it I will stop
Of course, you only have a one week obligation anyway
Alright, when do I start?
I will text you once I know more
Okay
Thank you for taking care of me and finding me work
It is normal, go rest a little you deserve your day off
